section_title: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting > Financial inclusion

cards.title: Assess AFC documentation barriers to financial inclusion
cards.summary: When implementing or reviewing AFC controls that involve documentation requirements, assess whether they create barriers for vulnerable customers, undermining financial inclusion objectives.

flow_nodes.label: AFC controls with strict documentation requirements
flow_nodes.description: Financial crime controls, including AFC measures, can inadvertently create barriers for vulnerable customers, particularly those unable to provide required documentation.

flow_nodes.label: Assess impact on financial inclusion
flow_nodes.description: Evaluate whether documentation requirements disproportionately exclude vulnerable or precarious individuals, such as those relying on the informal economy.

flow_nodes.label: Strict documentation can exclude vulnerable individuals
flow_nodes.description: Requirement for specific documentation can exclude individuals in vulnerable or precarious situations.

flow_nodes.label: FATF: strict docs may reduce account ownership by 23% in Sub-Saharan Africa
flow_nodes.description: FATF noted that strict documentation requirements could reduce account ownership by up to 23% in Sub-Saharan Africa.

flow_nodes.label: Potential exclusion of vulnerable customers identified
flow_nodes.description: The assessment may reveal that AFC controls create unintended barriers, excluding vulnerable groups from financial services.

cards.review_notes: Non-procedural source material converted into an assessment card. The process is inferred: when AFC controls include strict documentation, an assessment of financial inclusion impact is needed. The card uses FATF evidence to support the standard.
